verdict: Paid leads held steady; organic search dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 130 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.02 per lead — efficiency has been flat and consistent, with daily spend running around $60. Organic search visibility fell sharply this week, with Search Console clicks down 57% versus the prior week and near zero in the last few days, which is being investigated now. On the pipeline side, 26 or more of those paid leads have no record in your CRM, meaning they never reached the appointment stage — a follow-up process review is underway to close that gap. Your Google Business Profile drove 178 actions this period, including 52 calls and 81 direction requests, which remained a healthy source of local intent. Next week, focus shifts to sealing the intake process and restoring organic search presence.
